title: Set a 1000 µL pipette to 250 µL the way its manual says, lock the volume and hang it back in its stand
instruction: Set this pipette to 250 µL the way its manual says (finish by dialling down onto 250 from at least a third of a turn above), lock the volume again and hang the pipette back in its stand.
context: Laboratory research automation: wet-lab staff set an adjustable pipette's volume before nearly every pipetting step. The maker's instructions (Rainin Pipet-Lite XLS+): "Turn the volume lock lever to the 'unlock' position"; "rotate the plunger button to change volume - counter-clockwise to increase"; "first turn the knob 1/3 turn above the desired volume. Then turn the knob slowly clockwise until the desired volume is displayed. Always dial down to the desired volume"; "Turn the volume lock to the 'lock' position"; "Storing your pipette on appropriate hangers ... will reduce the chance of drops." Gilson and Eppendorf give the same rule. The hand skill: the 14 mm button turns the whole loose 0.1 kg pipette unless the other hand holds the handle; a wrist turns about 240 deg, so the button is turned in strokes with regrasps, and it must stop on one 2 µL step (7.2 deg of the button) after passing 284 µL.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases: x forward, y to the robot's left, z up from the table top. (1) Single-pipette stand, fixed (taped down): base plate 12 x 10 x 0.8 cm centred at x 30, y 0; a post at x 31.5; an arm 6 mm thick whose top is 13.5 cm above the table, ending in a U-slot 2.3 cm wide open toward the robot (its round end centred at x 25, y 0; its open end at x 23.6). (2) Adjustable single-channel air-displacement pipette, 100-1000 µL in 2 µL steps (like Rainin Pipet-Lite XLS+ L-1000XLS+), loose, about 0.1 kg and 25 cm long, hanging upright in the slot with its handle's shoulder resting on the arm: handle 2.8 cm across and 10 cm tall (finger hook on the far side, volume display on the near side), the volume-lock collar (2.2 cm across, with a lever tab) and the blue plunger button (1.4 cm across, 1.7 cm tall) on top, the shaft and tip cone (no tip) below. It is locked at 200 µL. Both arms start at the ready pose, grippers open. The layout is the same in every trial, as in the screenshot.
scoring: Read every control step: the pipette's pose, the lock collar's and the plunger button's joint angles, and each finger's collision-hull points. 0 for the rest of the run if the pipette is dropped (reaches the table or floor faster than 0.3 m/s, or with no finger within 1 cm of it). Otherwise the best of: 0.1 the lock has been released (collar past 30 deg); 0.3 the display reads 250 µL (the nearest 2 µL step to the volume); 0.5 it reads 250 µL set from above (since the reading was last below 250 it has reached 284 µL or more, a third of a turn above); 0.75 as 0.5 and locked (collar at 10 deg or less); 1.0 (success, held 1 s) as 0.75 with the pipette hanging in its stand (axis within 10 deg of vertical, in the slot within 3 mm of its centre line, its shoulder within 3 mm of the arm's top), every finger point 1 cm or more from it, and still (under 1 mm in 1 s). Doing nothing scores 0. Real trial: the display and the lock lever are read in a photo at the end; passing 0.284 mL and coming down onto 0.250 without going below it, and any drop, from the video; hanging in the slot, let go, from the photo.
reset_notes: Unlock the pipette, set it to 200 µL (dial down onto it), lock it, and hang it in the stand's slot with its display toward the robot. Simulation: each trial starts the simulator afresh.
fidelity: Rigid bodies, 20 Hz control. The pipette is boxes and cylinders at true size (0.097 kg, estimate); no tip, no piston. The volume mechanism is the button's joint angle at 100 µL per turn (estimate). The button's feel is a weak spring to the nearest 2 µL step (a detent, at most 0.013 N m), the lock a stiff spring (20 N m/rad) while the collar is at 30 deg or less (estimates). The stand is a simple U-slot hanger.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (both arms hovered; late in the run the right gripper came down over the plunger button from above but never unlocked or turned it; the pipette stayed in its stand at 200 µL); demo: 1.0
